about: Installer presets: a preset is a list of workflows; the installer downloads every model those workflows need.

presets.title: Starter 66 GB
presets.summary: Qwen Image 2.1 text to image, SeedVR2 and Real-ESRGAN upscales, and InfiniteTalk talking videos. No Hugging Face token needed.

presets.title: FLUX 3 Klein 11 GB
presets.summary: FLUX 3 Image Klein text to image and editing with up to 4 references. Gated: accept the license on Hugging Face and set HF_TOKEN.

presets.title: Instant scene + sound
presets.summary: FastH3 Omni: pictures, video and audio in, a scene with synced sound out, in 8 steps.

presets.title: Video
presets.summary: LTX 2.5 (text, image, first-last frame, with sound), Wan 2.2 image-to-video and transitions, RIFE and SeedVR2 video upscale. LTX 2.5 needs HF_TOKEN.

presets.title: Talking + H3
presets.summary: MiniMax H3 image-to-video, talking pictures, reference-to-video, Character Swap, FastH3 Omni and InfiniteTalk, and SolarRenderer (structure video to cinematic clip).

presets.title: Everything
presets.summary: Every model of every workflow. Big: check the size and the monthly storage cost first.
